title: Vegan junk food
text: A friend sent this to me as a gift. Most of this is not even organic, and is just cheap junk that happens to be vegan.  Many things in here have huge amounts of sugar and unhealthy oils, and a shocking amount of sodium.  Some even have corn syrup, and one chocolate bar comes with a California cancer warning.  I wouldn’t call any of this “food”.  Don’t poison yourself with this crap;  eat real food that doesn’t come in a wrapper.
label: negative
